# Contract: BudgetsRepository

Local-only Domain/Data boundary (see 001's `people_repository.md` for why this replaces a network API contract). All methods return `Either<Failure, T>`. `BudgetsRepositoryImpl` is constructed with `FinanceRepository` and `CategoryRepository` (both 007, unchanged interfaces) as dependencies — see research.md Decision 1.

```dart
abstract class BudgetsRepository {
  /// Creates a new budget for [month] (FR-001). [idempotencyKey] is
  /// generated by the caller at "Save" time; a retried call with the same
  /// key returns the already-persisted budget rather than creating a
  /// second one (FR-017). Returns BudgetAlreadyExistsForMonthFailure if a
  /// non-deleted Budget already exists for [month] (data-model.md unique
  /// constraint) — the caller should route the user to editing it instead.
  Future<Either<Failure, Budget>> createBudget({
    required String idempotencyKey,
    required String month,
    int? expectedIncomeMinorUnits,
  });

  /// Edits a budget's expected income figure (FR-003). Category
  /// allocations are managed via the dedicated methods below, not here.
  Future<Either<Failure, Budget>> editBudget({
    required String budgetId,
    int? expectedIncomeMinorUnits,
  });

  /// Soft-deletes a budget after the caller has shown a confirmation
  /// (FR-011). Never touches FinanceEntry/Category data (FR-022).
  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> deleteBudget(String budgetId);

  /// Creates a new Budget for [targetMonth] by copying every
  /// BudgetCategoryAllocation from [sourceBudgetId] (FR-012). The two
  /// budgets share no ongoing link afterward — editing one never affects
  /// the other. Fails with BudgetAlreadyExistsForMonthFailure if
  /// [targetMonth] already has a non-deleted budget.
  Future<Either<Failure, Budget>> copyBudgetToMonth({
    required String idempotencyKey,
    required String sourceBudgetId,
    required String targetMonth,
  });

  /// Adds a planned allocation for [categoryId] to [budgetId] (FR-001).
  /// [categoryId] MUST reference an expense-type Category (007); rejects
  /// a duplicate allocation for the same category (data-model.md unique
  /// constraint) and a negative plannedAmountMinorUnits (FR-002).
  Future<Either<Failure, BudgetCategoryAllocation>> addBudgetCategoryAllocation({
    required String idempotencyKey,
    required String budgetId,
    required String categoryId,
    required int plannedAmountMinorUnits,
  });

  /// Edits an existing allocation's planned amount (FR-010).
  Future<Either<Failure, BudgetCategoryAllocation>> editBudgetCategoryAllocation({
    required String allocationId,
    required int plannedAmountMinorUnits,
  });

  /// Removes a category from a budget (FR-010). Its spending (if any)
  /// becomes "unbudgeted" for that month afterward (FR-007). Hard delete
  /// — no audit trail needed for plan data (research.md Decision 5).
  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> removeBudgetCategoryAllocation(
    String allocationId,
  );

  /// Full computed detail for [month]: the Budget itself (if one exists),
  /// its BudgetSummary (planned/actual/remaining/percentage/over-budget,
  /// FR-005/FR-006/FR-009), its per-category BudgetCategoryLine list
  /// (FR-005/FR-008), and its unbudgeted-spending list (FR-007). Returns
  /// a null Budget (not a Failure) when [month] has no budget yet, so the
  /// caller can render the FR-018 empty/offer-to-copy state — an absent
  /// budget for a given month is a normal, expected outcome, not an
  /// error.
  Future<Either<Failure, BudgetMonthDetail>> getBudgetForMonth(String month);

  /// Planned-vs-actual data points for the most recent [monthsBack]
  /// months (default 6, FR-014/Assumptions), either overall
  /// ([categoryId] null) or for one category. Includes months with no
  /// Budget row as zero-planned data points, per data-model.md's
  /// BudgetTrendPoint rule; the caller applies the "needs at least 2
  /// months with an actual Budget" empty-state check using the returned
  /// points' planned figures.
  Future<Either<Failure, List<BudgetTrendPoint>>> getBudgetTrend({
    String? categoryId,
    int monthsBack = 6,
  });
}
```

**Failure modes**: `ValidationFailure` (negative planned amount, invalid month format), `BudgetAlreadyExistsForMonthFailure`, `BudgetNotFoundFailure`, `NotFoundFailure` (unknown allocation/category id), `CacheFailure`, `UnknownFailure`.

**Idempotency note**: `createBudget`, `copyBudgetToMonth`, and `addBudgetCategoryAllocation` take an `idempotencyKey`, for the same reason established in 001/008/009 — they are the calls a rapid double-tap or retry could duplicate. `editBudget`/`editBudgetCategoryAllocation`/`deleteBudget`/`removeBudgetCategoryAllocation` act on an already-identified id, so a retried call is naturally idempotent.

**Cross-feature note**: `getBudgetForMonth`/`getBudgetTrend` internally call 007's `CategoryRepository.getCategories`/`FinanceRepository.getCategoryBreakdown` (research.md Decision 2) — this contract never queries `FinanceEntries`/`FinanceCategories` directly, satisfying FR-016.
